desc: The Girls With Guns Black Label Rifle Sling was designed by women for women using the Girls With Guns Black Label finish. Features a unique gripping action with the non-slip rubber backing to keep your firearm safely in place. Ergonomically designed with a lightweight rubber mold to conform to the shoulder, providing additional comfort. Go hands-free with the Black Label Rifle Sling and keep your rifle steady in place while out in the field!
